quotes.text: The books table will hold the core information about each book, and the library table will hold each user’s information about that book—namely, whether it’s been read or wishlisted.
quotes.reference: 2017 September, John S. Tonello, “The Full Stack Project”, in Linux Journal, number 281, page 81:

quotes.text: The titles featured saw staggering numbers of people checking out their store pages and wishlisting the games (this is key, as on launch day, an email is sent to remind players to pick up the game).
